parsed.name: 多功能酶标仪
parsed.description: 用于读取微孔板中各孔的吸光度、荧光和发光信号的实验仪器，常用于生化分析、细胞实验和板式检测流程。
parsed.description_en: An instrument used to read absorbance, fluorescence, and luminescence signals from wells in a microplate, commonly used for biochemical assays, cell-based experiments, and plate-based analytical workflows.

actions.description: 将微孔板资源分配并装载到酶标仪中。
actions.description_en: Assign and load a microplate resource into the plate reader.

actions.description: 关闭酶标仪的舱门或托盘，以准备检测。
actions.description_en: Close the plate reader door or tray to prepare for measurement.

actions.description: 打开酶标仪的舱门或托盘，以便放入或取出微孔板。
actions.description_en: Open the plate reader door or tray to insert or remove a microplate.

actions.description: 在指定波长下读取微孔板各孔的吸光度。
actions.description_en: Read absorbance from the wells of a microplate at a specified wavelength.

actions.description: 在指定激发波长、发射波长和焦高条件下读取微孔板各孔的荧光信号。
actions.description_en: Read fluorescence from the wells of a microplate using specified excitation wavelength, emission wavelength, and focal height.

actions.description: 在指定焦高条件下读取微孔板各孔的发光信号。
actions.description_en: Read luminescence from the wells of a microplate at a specified focal height.

actions.description: 序列化酶标仪的当前状态或资源信息。
actions.description_en: Serialize the current state or resource information of the plate reader.

actions.description: 获取当前装载的微孔板。
